email_subject: Application - Marketing Manager (Maternity Cover) at picdrop
email_body:
Dear saas.group team,

I'm applying for the Marketing Manager (Maternity Cover) role at picdrop. Your description of a hands-on generalist who can keep partner, affiliate and influencer programs running while testing B2B lead generation in DACH immediately appealed to me.

In my current roles, I manage SEO content and CMS work for client sites, build WordPress sites from scratch, and use analytics to guide decisions. I've also designed and launched my own sites, including mirook.com, where I implemented structured data and ran technical audits that measurably improved search health. While I haven't run affiliate programs at scale, I've owned end-to-end projects and am comfortable with numbers, events, and writing in English and German (B1 writing, A2+ speaking). I'm eager to apply my generalist skills to picdrop's partner and event initiatives.

I'd welcome the chance to discuss how I can contribute during this 12-month cover.

Best regards,
Baver Ok

cover_letter:
Dear saas.group team,

I'm writing to apply for the Marketing Manager (Maternity Cover) position at picdrop. The role's focus on owning partner, affiliate and influencer programs while testing B2B lead generation in the DACH market aligns closely with the generalist, hands-on marketing work I've been doing.

In my current freelance and junior digital marketing roles, I manage SEO content, CMS updates, and website builds for client sites. I've designed and launched my own WordPress sites, including baverok.com and mirook.com, where I implemented structured data, ran technical audits, and used analytics to improve search visibility. At Episto, I handle on-page SEO, keyword research, and content publishing for client websites, tracking results with Semrush, Ahrefs, Google Analytics and Search Console. These experiences have taught me to turn data into decisions and to own projects end to end.

While I haven't managed affiliate programs at scale, I've coordinated partner-like relationships with clients and stakeholders, and I'm comfortable with the financial and reporting aspects of such programs. I've also planned and executed website launches and content campaigns, which required event-like coordination and follow-up. My writing skills in English are strong, and I'm building my German (B1 writing, A2+ speaking), so I can draft landing pages and email sequences in both languages with some support.

I'm drawn to picdrop's photographer-driven mission and the creative industry focus. I understand the importance of intuitive tools for creative professionals and would relish the chance to help grow the partner ecosystem and event presence. I'm a fast learner who thrives in small teams with minimal structure, and I'm excited about the autonomy and ownership this role offers.

Thank you for considering my application. I'd love to discuss how my skills can support picdrop during this 12-month cover.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
